explanation: Green's Problem 1 (now marked "Solved" in the December 2025 version): does every set A of n positive integers contain a sum-free subset of size n/3 + Ω(n) with Ω(n) → ∞? The formalization asserts a single function Ω tending to infinity that works uniformly for all n and all A of size n. This is the intended reading. IsSumFree is the standard notion. The `research solved` tag matches Bedert's 2025 result (n/3 + c log log n). The statement is faithful.
